test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Neither Q nor S sit at the exact central position of the row. R is adjacent to S, while P and T are sitting at the extreme ends of the row. Who is sitting at the exact central position of the row?
solution:
**Given:** P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) P and T are sitting at the extreme ends of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b38a1319da2e015545cce02c6013eb69017d6f632df54292a70cec64d86f295.png] 

2) Neither Q nor S sit at the exact central position of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a491f3c29ca6e56d292d9cdf895f5bb6ddc729d67d5262463c4b0cfc24e6a10f.png] 

3) R is adjacent to S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8675ee46e09ca902f2976954af2fdbe97dabd496e9f3545761b421be1c08f681.png] 

Here, in both the cases the position of 'R' is same.

So, '**R**' is sitting at the exact central position of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
